description: Query live physical perception events from the Afferens sensory layer. Returns real-time sensor data your AI agent can act on — object detections, positions, sounds, environmental readings, chemical traces, and node health. Requires AFFERENS_API_KEY (free tier: 10,000 tokens, no card required — sign up at afferens.com).

limit.description: Max number of perception events to return (1-50, default 10).

modality.description: Sensory modality to query. Omit to get events across all modalities.

name: afferens_perceive
